source.redistribution_note: BLS-published material is public domain except identified third-party material. Attribute the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, retain archive URLs and release dates, and do not use the protected BLS emblem.

interval.availability_rule: Each selected BLS Import and Export Price Index release states that transmission is embargoed until 8:30 a.m. EST or EDT on its named release date. FinReplay validates the weekday and timezone abbreviation against America/New_York, cross-checks the complete archived HTML and PDF, and makes the snapshot eligible at that exact time. Current retrieval metadata is never backdated.

payload.covid_methodology_statement: Coronavirus (COVID-19) Impact on March 2020 Import and Export Price Index Survey Data The import and export price quotes are requested for transactions occurring as close to the first day of the month as possible. While not directly related to the COVID-19 pandemic, response rates for March were approximately 6.5 percentage points lower than March 2019. No changes in estimation procedures were necessary.
payload.measurement_boundary: U.S. dollar prices paid by U.S. importers; generally f.o.b. foreign-port or c.i.f. U.S.-port transaction prices, aggregated as a modified Laspeyres price index
payload.release_series: U.S. Import and Export Price Indexes
payload.snapshot_semantics: all-import monthly change reported in this archived release

claim_boundary: This lock preserves the originally released -230-basis-point March 2020 all-import monthly change solely as a post-decision event. It also retains the later -70-basis-point February value and its -20-basis-point revision from the locked -50 first report. The event is 130 basis points below the fixed -100 lower endpoint; the visible miss does not widen the range. The event is excluded from all ReplayPack inputs and does not establish forecast skill, calibrated coverage, import quantities or nominal trade value, tariff or CPI effects, importer or firm behavior, pandemic causality, investment performance, external review, deployment, or user impact.
